mentions.name: ShrewDNS
mentions.description: This is a networking-over-DNS client and server written in Go. It acts as a building block that represents DNS channels as UDP endpoints, allowing users to build custom network topologies on top — for example running WireGuard, SSH, a SOCKS5 proxy (via quicmux over QUIC), or even Mosh straight over DNS. It also ships with an Android app.
